question_text: Will RWA market cap on Avalanche be above $700 on Jan 1, 2026?
resolution_criteria:
If the total RWA market cap on Avalanche is above 700 at 10:00 AM ET on Jan 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
The market measures the total market capitalization in USD of all Real World Asset tokens on the specified blockchain, including all layers, subnets, parachains, or equivalent network divisions, as calculated by DeFiLlama at 10:00 AM ET on the measurement date. If DeFiLlama data is unavailable at the specified time, the last available value will be used. The blockchain must be actively tracked by DeFiLlama with RWA data available.
